statement.p: (Not randomizable) Suppose you have used long division to divide the polynomial (7x^2 -3x + 5) by (x+1)\text{.} Suppose you found that the remainder is 15 and the quotient is 7x-10\text{.} Write the result in the format of (1.3.1).
Note: If the help buttons on the right side block part of the question, click somewhere else in the question to temporarily hide the buttons.
